_doc: Side quests (bounties) from the original quests.js: target = node id or encounter id in a zone; done when that node is cleared / encounter beaten. Reward gold (+fame). Offered on the town's board (Quests tab) once the act is reached. Every act carries at least two of its own (tests/quests.test.js checks that, and that every targetNode is a real node), and an accepted one with a targetNode puts a marker on the map.

quests.title: The Brood Mother
quests.text: Something in Thornwood lays eggs in the caravans. Burn out the nest.

quests.title: Obsidian Garrison
quests.text: The Ashen Veil holds the old fort on the Dust Roads. Take it back.

quests.title: The High Priest
quests.text: Kill the Veil High Priest before the ritual completes.

quests.title: Inferno Keep
quests.text: Clear the keep at the mouth of the breach.

quests.title: The Demon Reliquary
quests.text: Recover what the demons keep in their reliquary.

quests.title: Memory Crypt
quests.text: The crypt remembers everyone who died here. Silence it.

quests.title: Shard Fortress
quests.text: Break the fortress the void built out of pieces of the sky.

quests.title: The Nexus Ambush
quests.text: Spring the trap at the nexus before it springs on someone else.

quests.title: Abyssal Garrison
quests.text: The abyss keeps soldiers. Fewer, please.

quests.title: Dragon Patrol
quests.text: Thin the patrols on the Dragon's Reach.

quests.title: The King's Trial
quests.text: Whatever the Dragon King keeps for a doorman, put it down before the throne room.

quests.title: Heads on Pikes
quests.text: Bring down three named foes. The board pays per head.
